mods.name: Texture Replacer
mods.author: kumarin
mods.description:
Replaces game textures at runtime with .png files from BepInEx/plugins/ModImages, which is where texture packs install to. A generic BepInEx plugin for Unity games; this is its IL2CPP build, which Secret Flasher Manaka needs. Alt+F11 dumps the game's textures to ModImagesDump, F12 switches between texture sets in ModImages/Select.
Source: https://f95zone.to/threads/bepinex-plugin-texture-replacer-v1-3-0-0.118422/
mods.note: Only Texture_Replacer_BE_il2cpp.dll is imported; the archive's Texture_Replacer_BE5.dll is the Mono build, which this game cannot load. 1.0.8.2 (the old MD5 build) left out. The community 'SFM Performance Fix' (post 20391867) is a patched 1.1.0.1: it predates the file naming current texture packs use and no longer replaces textures of NPCs that spawn later, so it is not imported.
